summary: You offer doctor-led skin treatments in the CBD, but several sections of the homepage appear empty and booking is by phone only.

findings.problem: What Our Clients Are Saying and two product sections have headings but appear to show nothing.
findings.cost: Empty reviews and shop sections look broken and give no proof.
findings.fix: Real reviews and a working product section.

findings.problem: Leftover text shows: Use left/right arrows to navigate the slideshow, View cart (), and an image alt reads Wendy.png with a long ID.
findings.cost: Stray system text makes a clinic site look unfinished.
findings.fix: Clean content and proper image text.

findings.problem: Booking is by phone only, open Wednesday to Friday 9am to 5pm. No form, no WhatsApp.
findings.cost: Evening visitors and mobile users who want to book now leave.
findings.fix: Online booking form and WhatsApp button.

findings.problem: The page says Doctor led but names no doctor, shows no before and after, and Brands links to #.
findings.cost: Cosmetic patients want to know who treats them and see results.
findings.fix: Doctor profile and a results gallery.

redesign: Online booking and WhatsApp so patients can book any time.
A doctor profile, reviews and results gallery that prove quality.
